sinopsis.es: Una joven inocente, cuidada con celo por su madre, queda en medio del conflicto entre dos pretendientes: un primo que se las da de poeta y un arriero de la finca. Su madre intenta ayudarla, pero es en vano, y la joven sufre las consecuencias injustas de la rivalidad.
sinopsis.en: An innocent young girl, jealously cared for and protected by her mother, finds herself in the middle of a conflict between two suitors who seek to conquer her, the first is a cousin who poses as a poet and the other is a muleteer of the farm. Her mother tries to help her but to no avail, and the young girl suffers the unjust consequences of the rivalry.
